svg.text: Condition editor — the friendly view (ImGui default dark; real FontAwesome glyphs; every element is one ImGui call — design §4)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
Choose an area — the rule cannot be applied until every blank is filled
Custom condition (Expert) — Blueprint variable of "Sniper team" · Open in Expert view
A ROW = WHO · IS / HAS · VALUE, as a sentence; an icon only
INSIDE the chip it describes (skull on destroyed …).
WHO can be a group: any / at least N / all / none
of a side or of a unit's men ⇒ CountMatching.
Friendly facts, not component paths: strength,
NOT is a choice of the verb: is / is not —
An unfilled blank: red frame + the reason;
Apply stays disabled until the rule is complete.
One nesting level: a group says All / Any / None,
Anything the friendly view cannot draw is ONE
dashed row — kept, never rewritten (Expert view).
Add condition opens the menu on the right;
Timing belongs to the rule (holdFor · delay ·
repeat), written as the end of the sentence.
LIVE: ✓ / ✗ per row and the number behind it
(the existing Live strip, matched by the same sentence)
Add condition — grouped, filtered to what fits a rule; type to search
any of a side is inside …
at least N of … are destroyed
all of a unit's men are …
PRESET Take and hold an area
PRESET Side has lost N men
Debugging kinds (trace buffer, ring entry, hit tag) appear only in the replay search and breakpoints — a kind's Contexts decides.
